name: PDF Annotation
description:
Mark up PDFs in the page with highlights, drawings, shapes, text, sticky notes and stamps, then save the annotations or export an annotated PDF.

Source: any region source; the first row is the document. Map ID, File Name and the PDF (BLOB) or a URL, plus the column with saved annotations. Tools: highlight (selected text, or an area on scanned pages), pen, rectangle, ellipse, arrow, line, text box, sticky note with comment, stamps (Approved, Rejected and your own), eraser; select to move, recolor or delete; undo and redo; colors and line widths. Comments panel: every annotation with author, time and comment; click to jump to it.

Live demo: sign in as demo with the password Demo.

Requires Oracle APEX 26.2 or later. Documentation, updates and more plug-ins by TechRevX.
